描述_EN: that the great wisdom and understanding of sakyamuni permeates all things like the scent of orchids. that the donors offer their praise. it expresses the donors' faith in the divine light that banishes bodies as if they were dirt. that its great beauty springs from the source of inspiration. it also expresses the wish that through the attainment of divine understanding one should pass into a state of calm and tranquil purity. it probably stood in a public place for passers-by to worship. it probably came from north china, from the borders of shaanxi and henan provinces. it is inscribed with the date of 544 ad and was paid for by five donors, three of them members of the same family. many chinese buddhist images and artefacts were produced during the great period of expansion of the religion in the sixth century ad, and this sculpture is one of the v&a's foremost buddhist stone carvings. on the face of the plinth, the long inscription states that the stele was carved as a memorial to one li hung-yen. this limestone carving of the buddha with two attendant bodhisattvas is typical in its style of late wei sculpture. that the stone was 'auspiciously carved' as a palace image so as to compare with that which is beyond compare. and, finally, that this sacrifice be as great as those of the past.
描述_ZN: 释迦牟尼的伟大智慧和理解像兰花的香味一样渗透到所有的事物中。 说明捐赠者提供了他们的赞美。 它表达了捐赠者对神圣之光的信仰，它驱逐了身体，就像它们是灰尘一样。 它的伟大之美来自灵感的源泉。 它还表达了这样的愿望：通过获得神圣的理解，人们应该进入一种平静和安宁的纯洁状态。 它可能矗立在一个公共场所，供过往的行人朝拜。 它可能来自中国北方，来自陕西省和河南省的边界。 它刻有公元544年的日期，由五个捐赠者支付，其中三个是同一家族的成员。 许多中国佛教的图像和工艺品是在公元六世纪该宗教的伟大扩张时期产生的，而这个雕塑是V&A最重要的佛教石雕之一。 在基座的表面，长长的铭文写道，这块石碑是为了纪念李洪彦而刻的。 这个石灰岩雕刻的菩萨和两个随从的菩萨是典型的晚期魏国雕塑风格。 这块石头被 "吉祥地雕刻 "为宫殿的形象，以便与那无法比拟的东西相比。 最后，希望这次祭祀能像过去的祭祀一样伟大。
